title: Move-Out Worksheet Note — Final Month Pet Fees in the Independent Living Closing Amount
content:
**Rule.** The final month's registered pets add to the closing amount of an Independent Living Residency Agreement at the monthly pet fee per pet without proration, the number of pets being the quantity on the latest pet monthly fee charge (latest by service date): two or more registered pets add the monthly pet fee once for each pet to the closing amount; one registered pet adds the monthly pet fee once to the closing amount; no pet monthly fee charge adds no pet amount to the closing amount.

## Worksheet by apartment type

| Apartment type | Monthly pet fee | Quantity 1 adds | Quantity 2 adds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 35.00 | 35.00 | — |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 35.00 | 35.00 | — |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 40.00 | 40.00 | 80.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 40.00 | 40.00 | 80.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 45.00 | 45.00 | 90.00 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

A dash marks a quantity the apartment type does not permit.

## Worked lines (hypothetical)

- One-Bedroom Deluxe, latest pet monthly fee charge quantity 2: 80.00 added to the closing amount.
- Studio, latest pet monthly fee charge quantity 1: 35.00 added.
- No pet monthly fee charge on the ledger: nothing added.

The pet amount is a whole month's fee per pet even when the final month is partly used.
